# server_version_num=170010 (expected to differ between local and live; not a stop)
table task_history: owner=postgres rls=true force_rls=false
table tasks: owner=postgres rls=true force_rls=false
column task_history #01 id bigint NOT NULL IDENTITY ALWAYS
column task_history #02 task_id uuid NOT NULL
column task_history #03 at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
column task_history #04 actor text NOT NULL
column task_history #05 op text NOT NULL
column task_history #06 changed_fields text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::text[]
column task_history #07 old jsonb
column task_history #08 new jsonb
column task_history #09 flags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::text[]
column tasks #01 id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
column tasks #02 title text NOT NULL
column tasks #03 description text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
column tasks #04 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo'::text
column tasks #05 raci jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
column tasks #06 links jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
column tasks #07 created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
column tasks #08 updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
column tasks #09 short_id bigint NOT NULL IDENTITY ALWAYS
column tasks #10 owner text GENERATED (raci ->> 'r'::text)
column tasks #11 created_by text
column tasks #12 closed_at timestamp with time zone
column tasks #13 closing_note text
column tasks #14 needed_by date
column tasks #15 parent_id uuid
column tasks #16 tags text[]
column tasks #17 addressed_to text
column tasks #18 signed_at timestamp with time zone
column tasks #19 signed_ref text
column tasks #20 linear_id text
column tasks #21 linear_status text
column tasks #22 search tsvector GENERATED to_tsvector('english'::regconfig, ((COALESCE(title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(description, ''::text)))
constraint task_history.task_history_op_check: CHECK ((op = ANY (ARRAY['insert'::text, 'update'::text])))
constraint task_history.task_history_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint tasks.tasks_addressed_to_shape: CHECK (((addressed_to IS NULL) OR (addressed_to ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$'::text)))
constraint tasks.tasks_closed_needs_note: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['done'::text, 'decided_against'::text])) OR ((COALESCE(btrim(closing_note), ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL))))
constraint tasks.tasks_description_check: CHECK ((char_length(description) <= 600))
constraint tasks.tasks_justin_needs_date: CHECK (((lower(addressed_to) IS DISTINCT FROM 'justin'::text) OR (needed_by IS NOT NULL)))
constraint tasks.tasks_one_owner: CHECK ((COALESCE(btrim((raci ->> 'r'::text)), ''::text) <> ''::text))
constraint tasks.tasks_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint tasks.tasks_signed_needs_ref: CHECK (((signed_at IS NULL) OR (COALESCE(btrim(signed_ref), ''::text) <> ''::text)))
constraint tasks.tasks_status_allowed: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'in_progress'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'done'::text, 'decided_against'::text, 'proposed'::text])))
constraint tasks.tasks_title_max_80: CHECK ((char_length(title) <= 80))
index task_history.task_history_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX task_history_pkey ON public.task_history USING btree (id)
index task_history.task_history_task_id_id_idx: CREATE INDEX task_history_task_id_id_idx ON public.task_history USING btree (task_id, id)
index tasks.tasks_addressed_to_status_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_addressed_to_status_idx ON public.tasks USING btree (addressed_to, status)
index tasks.tasks_closed_at_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_closed_at_idx ON public.tasks USING btree (closed_at)
index tasks.tasks_linear_id_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_linear_id_key ON public.tasks USING btree (linear_id)
index tasks.tasks_owner_status_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_owner_status_idx ON public.tasks USING btree (owner, status)
index tasks.tasks_parent_id_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_parent_id_idx ON public.tasks USING btree (parent_id)
index tasks.tasks_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_pkey ON public.tasks USING btree (id)
index tasks.tasks_search_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_search_idx ON public.tasks USING gin (search)
index tasks.tasks_short_id_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_short_id_key ON public.tasks USING btree (short_id)
trigger task_history.task_history_guard_insert: CREATE TRIGGER task_history_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.task_history FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION task_history_guard_insert() [enabled=O]
trigger task_history.task_history_refuse_change: CREATE TRIGGER task_history_refuse_change BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.task_history FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION task_history_refuse_change() [enabled=O]
trigger tasks.tasks_after_write: CREATE TRIGGER tasks_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.tasks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION tasks_after_write() [enabled=O]
trigger tasks.tasks_before_write: CREATE TRIGGER tasks_before_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.tasks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION tasks_before_write() [enabled=O]
trigger tasks.tasks_refuse_delete: CREATE TRIGGER tasks_refuse_delete BEFORE DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON public.tasks FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION tasks_refuse_delete() [enabled=O]
policy task_history.service_role_only: PERMISSIVE ALL to service_role using (true) with check (true)
policy tasks.service_role_only: PERMISSIVE ALL to service_role using (true) with check (true)
